command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/numba
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).

grep ENCFF933NSJ encode.md5 > /tmp/this.md5
md5sum -c /tmp/this.md5 || { echo "FAIL: BAM does not match ENCODE's published md5"; exit 1; }

python3 -u -c "import deeptools, pyBigWig; print('version\tdeeptools %s' % getattr(deeptools,'__version__','unknown')); print('version\tpyBigWig %s' % getattr(pyBigWig,'__version__','unknown'))"
nproc | awk '{print "nproc\t"$1}'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- inline instrument
CG=/sys/fs/cgroup
sampler() {
  : > /tmp/samples.tsv
  while : ; do
    mc=$(cat $CG/memory.current 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    cu=$(awk '/^usage_usec/{print $2; exit}' $CG/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    tk=$(df -k /tmp 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==2{print $3}')
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(date +%s)" "${mc:-0}" "${cu:-0}" "${tk:-0}" >> /tmp/samples.tsv
    sleep 1
  done
}
sampler & SPID=$!

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the real workload
# Whole genome at binSize 50, the resolution a real ChIP track is built at.
# --normalizeUsing None is load-bearing: it is what makes the coverage comparable to a
# base count at all. Any normalisation rescales the values and the identity below dies.
echo "== bamCoverage, whole genome =="
T0=$(date +%s)
bamCoverage -b ENCFF933NSJ.bam -o cov.bedgraph --outFileFormat bedgraph \
  --binSize 50 --normalizeUsing None -p "$(nproc)" > /tmp/bamcoverage.log 2>&1
RC=$?
T1=$(date +%s)
kill $SPID 2>/dev/null; wait $SPID 2>/dev/null
WALL=$((T1-T0))
echo "bamcoverage_rc	$RC"
echo "bamcoverage_wall_s	$WALL"
tail -5 /tmp/bamcoverage.log
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: bamCoverage exited $RC"; exit 1; }

awk -F'\t' -v wall="$WALL" '
  NR==1{cu0=$3}
  {if($2>mc)mc=$2; if($4>tk)tk=$4; cu=$3; n++}
  END{
    printf "peak_rss_mib\t%.0f\n", mc/1048576;
    printf "tmpfs_peak_mib\t%.0f\n", tk/1024;
    if(wall>0) printf "avg_cores\t%.2f\n", (cu-cu0)/(wall*1000000);
  }' /tmp/samples.tsv

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- shape checks
ROWS=$(wc -l < cov.bedgraph)
echo "bedgraph_rows	$ROWS"
test "$ROWS" -gt 1000000 || { echo "FAIL: only $ROWS bedgraph rows genome-wide"; exit 1; }

BAD=$(awk -F'\t' 'NF!=4 || $3<=$2 {n++} END{print n+0}' cov.bedgraph)
echo "malformed_rows	$BAD"
test "$BAD" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: $BAD rows malformed or non-increasing"; exit 1; }

NEG=$(awk -F'\t' '$4<0 {n++} END{print n+0}' cov.bedgraph)
echo "negative_coverage_rows	$NEG"
test "$NEG" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: $NEG rows have negative coverage"; exit 1; }

# ------------------------------------------- the candidate identity, MEASURED not asserted
# CLAIM UNDER TEST: with --normalizeUsing None, the integral of coverage over the genome is
# the number of bases the aligner placed, so
#     sum over rows of (end-start)*value  ==  samtools' 'bases mapped (cigar)'
# That would be a conservation identity, which beats any band. But deepTools and samtools do
# not necessarily count the same records by default (secondary and supplementary alignments,
# duplicates, MAPQ 0), and asserting equality before checking that would be a green check on
# the wrong metric -- the exact trap the cross-check rules name. So this run REPORTS the
# ratio to six decimals and gates only loosely; the tight assertion is earned on the next
# pass, once the flag semantics are matched and the residual is explained.
BM=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="bases_mapped_cigar"{print $2}' basis.tsv)
MR=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="reads_mapped"{print $2}' basis.tsv)
echo "samtools_bases_mapped_cigar	$BM"
echo "samtools_reads_mapped	$MR"

INT=$(awk -F'\t' '{s += ($3-$2)*$4} END{printf "%.0f", s}' cov.bedgraph)
echo "coverage_integral	$INT"
awk -v a="$INT" -v b="$BM" 'BEGIN{ if(b>0) printf "integral_over_samtools\t%.6f\n", a/b; }'

RATIO_OK=$(awk -v a="$INT" -v b="$BM" 'BEGIN{ if(b<=0){print 0; exit} r=a/b; if(r>0.95 && r<1.05) print 1; else print 0 }')
test "$RATIO_OK" = "1" || { echo "FAIL: coverage integral is not within 5% of samtools' mapped bases -- investigate the flag semantics before loosening this"; exit 1; }

# Genome span covered at all, as a sanity number for the page.
awk -F'\t' '$4>0{s += $3-$2} END{printf "bases_with_nonzero_coverage\t%.0f\n", s}' cov.bedgraph

{ echo -e "observable\tvalue"
  echo -e "bamcoverage_wall_s\t$WALL"
  echo -e "bedgraph_rows\t$ROWS"
  echo -e "coverage_integral\t$INT"
  echo -e "samtools_bases_mapped_cigar\t$BM"
} > /tmp/coverage.tsv

gzip -c cov.bedgraph > cov.bedgraph.gz
ls -l cov.bedgraph.gz | awk '{print "bedgraph_gz_bytes\t"$5}'
echo "DEEPTOOLS REAL OK"
